use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES

use Math = System.Math
use Point = (x: double, y: double)
use Pentagon = (x: double, y: double, radius: double)

let golden = (1.0D + Math.sqrt(5.0D)) / 2.0D
let shrink = 1.0D / (1.0D + golden)

towards(index: int) -> double =>
    Math.pi / 2.0D + 0.4D * Math.pi * cast double(index)

corner_of(shape: Pentagon, index: int) -> Point =>
    (let angle = towards(index)

     (x = shape.x + shape.radius * Math.cos(angle),
      y = shape.y + shape.radius * Math.sin(angle)))

inner(shape: Pentagon, index: int) -> Pentagon =>
    (let angle = towards(index)
     let smaller = shape.radius * shrink
     let reach = shape.radius - smaller

     (x = shape.x + reach * Math.cos(angle),
      y = shape.y + reach * Math.sin(angle),
      radius = smaller))

flake(shape: Pentagon, order: int) -> Pipe[Pentagon] is
    if order == 0 then
        yield shape
    else
        for index in 0..5 do
            yield in flake(inner(shape, index), order - 1)
        od
    fi
si

let whole = (x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D, radius = 1.0D)
let order = 5

for shown in 1::order do
    write_line(
        "order {shown}: {flake(whole, shown) |> count()} pentagons")
od

let palette =
    [(red = 214ub, green = 69ub, blue = 65ub),
     (red = 238ub, green = 150ub, blue = 57ub),
     (red = 88ub, green = 166ub, blue = 96ub),
     (red = 58ub, green = 120ub, blue = 190ub),
     (red = 140ub, green = 86ub, blue = 168ub)]

let image = IMAGE(600, 600)

let half = Math.sin(0.4D * Math.pi) + 0.04D
let middle = (1.0D - Math.cos(Math.pi / 5.0D)) / 2.0D

image.view(-half, middle - half, half, middle + half)

let shapes = SHAPES()

for index in 0..5 do
    let tint = palette[index]

    for leaf in flake(inner(whole, index), order - 1) do
        shapes.add(
            LIST((0..5) |> map(corner => corner_of(leaf, corner))),
            tint)
    od
od

image.fill(shapes)

image.write("pentaflake.png")

image.show("pentaflake.png")
